assumption: The definer role df_runtime_definer can be granted pg_signal_backend by the administrator (migration 0018 does GRANT pg_signal_backend TO df_runtime_definer; the service lock halt and restore terminate backends with it)
how_to_check: Run deploy/db/qualify-managed-postgres.sql as the cluster administrator (doadmin) against the staging cluster; it rolls back and changes nothing
if_it_fails: The halt cannot terminate a backend that holds the service lock: migration 0018 fails on the managed cluster. O1 must change the halt (for example a cancel-only path or a different role) before production

assumption: The migrator's temporary membership in df_runtime_definer can be revoked at the end of migration 0018 when the migrator is doadmin (REVOKE df_runtime_definer FROM current_user)
expected: The script prints Q02 ok and the membership is gone afterwards
if_it_fails: The migrator keeps standing access to every definer-owned table. O1 must change 0018 or the migrator role design

assumption: The cluster is PostgreSQL 17 or later and offers the pgvector extension
how_to_check: The same script prints the server version and whether the vector extension is available; migration 0004 creates it on staging
expected: version_num >= 170000 and the extension installs in schema df_ext
if_it_fails: transaction_timeout role defaults and vector columns cannot be used; choose another tier or engine version

assumption: A role can carry a role-level transaction_timeout (ALTER ROLE ... SET transaction_timeout) and the verifier can read it from pg_db_role_setting
how_to_check: Run deploy/db/grants.sql then deploy/db/verify-privileges.sql on staging
if_it_fails: The feed poll bound does not hold; S1 and O1 must find another enforcement

assumption: A backup role can dump every table under FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (df_backup needs BYPASSRLS, which only a superuser can grant)
how_to_check: Try to create df_backup with BYPASSRLS as doadmin on staging; if refused, decide the alternative (dump as the administrator from a restricted host)
expected: The role is created, or the alternative is chosen and written into create-roles.sh, grants.sql and verify-privileges.sql together
if_it_fails: Nightly logical backups fail at the database step; the managed backups remain the only recovery path

assumption: The cluster certificate carries the name used as DB_SERVER_NAME for verify-full, and the private host name resolves to a VPC address
how_to_check: From a staging host connect with sslmode=verify-full using deploy/db/run-admin-sql.sh
if_it_fails: verify-full cannot be used with the private name: choose the name the certificate carries or fix the DNS

assumption: A managed-cluster failover that moves the primary is followed by the firewall refresh within about 30 seconds and the db-gate reconnects
how_to_check: Trigger a failover on staging and watch df-net-rules-refresh and the db-gate's connections
expected: New connections succeed within one minute and the old address is no longer accepted
if_it_fails: The refresh period or the resolver stub needs tuning

assumption: The off-account backup target gives a credential that cannot delete or overwrite what it wrote, or the bucket has object lock (a Spaces-style key cannot be write-only)
how_to_check: Attempt a delete and an overwrite with the production backup credential against the off-account target
if_it_fails: The off-account copy does not protect against a stolen production credential; choose another target
